scope: Official Web player retains update/accept/draw ordering and adds honest bounded RAF/submission diagnostics

decision.order: An actual RAF token owns bounded sequential fixed updates, snapshot acceptance, then drawing; only one update transaction may be in flight
decision.withdrawn_draft: Render-first preparing the next Luau View while the old View remains visible advanced private camera/hit caches before input on the visible view was consumed
decision.finding: P2 reported by game owner and independent Codex Core reviewer; InputFrame/physical input has no presented-world/View history with which to reconstruct private Lua caches
decision.preservation: .cache/render-first-withdrawn-20261030 contains source/test/doc copies, SHA inventory, working diff and reason
decision.limits: Restoring the existing order removes the added whole-frame mismatch; it does not introduce historical event-time hit testing for preexisting worker/backlog conditions

diagnostics.existing_contract: Version1 counters, actual completed_intervals timestamps and acceptance gates remain unchanged
diagnostics.successful_submission_raf_intervals: Actual originating browser RAF timestamp intervals for successful world/UI/cursor submissions only
diagnostics.new_snapshot_raf_intervals: Only globally first shown valid advancing frames submitted under a scheduler RAF; manual/startup already-shown frames, repeats and regressions are excluded
diagnostics.paired_samples: At most 512 fixed primitive rows; detached frozen objects are constructed only for snapshot({includeRafSamples:true}) after window filtering
diagnostics.default_publication: The read-only default query and periodic 30-draw report contain summaries, never paired rows
diagnostics.wall_scopes: Preparation elapsed time includes worker/job waits. Submission and callback wall durations cover only the known synchronous drawing continuation after preparation. Cancelled/stale preparation does not contaminate active wall/deadline distributions
diagnostics.deadline_scope: Supplied RAF timestamp plus nominal target budget; estimated wall/readiness diagnostics, not GPU/OS/compositor acknowledgements

validation.command: node --test web/shared/async-scheduler.test.mjs web/shared/player-completion.test.mjs web/shared/player-profile-main.test.mjs web/shared/player-profile-main-backend.test.mjs web/shared/startup-player-entry.test.mjs web/shared/ordered-physical-player-entry.test.mjs web/shared/player-pointer.test.mjs
cases: An actual 15ms completion interval remains 15ms while originating RAF cadence is 10ms; no timestamp substitution makes it pass
Submission/callback synchronous wall 1ms remains distinct from awaited preparation 9ms
Original RAF token is preserved across a delayed actual worker backend; no stale draw, overlapping request or extra Core command
Private moving projector input is consumed before publishing the next ordinary fixed-tick View
Pause/hidden/reset/stop/restart generations cancel stale drawing; cancelled preparation retains counts without active wall/cadence contamination
High/low-refresh, timestamp rounding debt and bounded catch-up/drop behavior remain honest
Packed lease consumption and optional interpolation preserve canonical state
700 writes retain 512 primitive rows; default/stale queries construct no row objects; opt-in rows are filtered and frozen
Manual/startup, repeated/regressed/unknown frames, skipped/error/no-submission outcomes and nominal deadline estimates are explicit
Public accessor rejects malformed options and adds no runtime operation; existing save readiness, physical receipts and pointer behavior remain passing

independent_review.restored_scheduler_and_main: Codex /root/runtime_audit reviewed update/accept/draw, one-chain retirement, original RAF token, post-await synchronous wall boundaries, cancellation/epoch guards and private-camera regression; no additional concrete P1/P2 found
independent_review.metrics_helper: Codex /root/native_performance reviewed the helper implemented by /root/web_lifecycle; non-RAF wall pollution and cancelled-preparation pollution were corrected before the final run; no remaining concrete P1/P2 found in that scope
independent_review.reviewer_execution: Source-only reviews; no reviewer builds, browser workloads or tests are claimed

not_claimed: A final SDK artifact or final commit identity
A new actual browser FPS result or a pass of the owner's unchanged temporal gate
GPU/OS scanout, universal pixel correctness, historical input reconstruction or no memory leak/no GC
